findings.title: arch-spelling alias (sbf) parse site not pinned to a file/function
findings.problem: The design states `sbf` is accepted as an input alias for the `.bpfel` arch 'at parse time' and references 'parse/resolveTargetQuery consumers' without naming the concrete function/line, unlike every other edit site which is pinned to a verified line.
findings.fix: Name the arch-parse seam (the arch-name lookup used by std.Target.Query.parse / the arch fromName-style table in lib/std/Target.sig) and state exactly where the sbf -> .bpfel alias is added, ensuring sbf-solana-solana round-trips through `sig targets` back to the canonical { .bpfel, .solana, .solana }.

findings.title: .hash/.gnu.hash dynamic-symbol-hash section not in the DSO layout contract
findings.problem: Elf2.sig couples .dynsym to a hash section (ensureDynsymHashCapacity, targetDynsymHashInfo, appendDynsymHashEntry), so an exported entrypoint dynamic symbol implies a hash section, but PC3's readelf -a checklist does not list .hash/.gnu.hash or state whether a Solana loader tolerates it.
findings.fix: Add .hash/.gnu.hash to the PC3 capture checklist and record whether the reference Solana .so carries one; if the loader rejects it, note that the hash section must be suppressed for the solana target.

findings.title: R_BPF numeric values and lddw split unverified (carried as PC2)
findings.problem: lib/std/elf.sig has EM.BPF = 247 (line 2223) but no R_BPF enum; the R_BPF_* values and the two-slot lddw immediate layout in the §4.3 table are expected values pinned by PC2, so they are unverified by construction.
findings.fix: Run PC2 and overwrite §4.3's table with the measured readelf -r values before writing any src/link/Elf2.sig code, exactly as the design states. No design change required.
